verdict.rationale: Crossplane's official CLI documents rendering Composition Functions locally without a cluster [crossplane-docs-7]. That gives a preview of the resources a composition would produce before anything is applied. However, nothing shows a plan-style diff against live state that lists creates, updates, and destroys. Composition Revisions [crossplane-docs-15] manage change rollout rather than preview it. Missing for 10: a documented diff/plan of creates, updates, and destroys against existing resources; preview of managed-resource changes before reconciliation; hands-on or independent corroboration.
